entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: Cataclysmic final conflict of the Otarian crisis on Otaria in the Rift Era.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess who conquered Otaria from Eroshia and was killed with the Mirari-sword, leaving Jeska.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Planeswalker who ascended from Karona's body when her spark ignited.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Former barbarian turned druid and warrior once Karona's ally; confronted her with the Mirari-sword.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Ancient numen who suffocated, imprisoned in stone.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Ancient numen trampled beneath his magma giant.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Most powerful numen, the last, annihilated by Karona.

entities.name: Sash
entities.description: Unman born of Lowallyn's magic who turned on Karona.

entities.name: Waistcoat
entities.description: Unman born of Lowallyn's magic who turned on Karona.

entities.name: Lord Macht
entities.description: Mysterious figure revealed to be Karn, a silver golem Planeswalker.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem and Planeswalker who took Karona and the Mirari to Argentum.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact whose sword form pierced Karona.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: What the guardian of Argentum would one day become.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: Where Karn took Karona's body and the Mirari.

events.summary: Karona raises an army at Eroshia, and razes Aphetto and other cities.
events.quote: Aphetto was razed, leaving only a black crater behind

events.summary: The numena unite against Karona and are defeated one by one.
A stray thought from Kamahl empowers Karona to annihilate Averru's city and Averru; the last numen is dead.
Lord Macht tells Kamahl only the Mirari-sword can stand against Karona; Kamahl fights but is disarmed.
events.quote: Karona disarmed him and prepared to strike him down

events.summary: Sash and Waistcoat, under Macht's instruction, pierce Karona with the Mirari-sword, ending her reign.
events.quote: they pierced her with the Mirari-sword, ending her reign and releasing all the magic back into the world

events.summary: Macht reveals himself as Karn and takes Karona's body to Argentum, where Jeska emerges as a Planeswalker.
events.quote: she was reborn not as a goddess but as a true Planeswalker

events.summary: Karn leaves the Mirari in a guardian for Argentum; Jeska and Karn depart, Kamahl and Stonebrow wander together.
events.quote: Together, Jeska and Karn departed to walk the planes

relations.quote: they pierced her with the Mirari-sword
revealing his true identity: Karn , silver golem and Planeswalker
Kamahl and his sole surviving ally Stonebrow
